services.desc: Join us for Mill After Dark, a fabulous evening of drag, glamour, and high-energy performances at Millspace in Newmarket. Hosted by Gem Fatale and Saison, the night features dazzling performances from Bianca York, and a special guest. Expect stunning looks, fierce lip syncs, comedy, and unforgettable moments from some of New England’s most exciting drag performers. Bring your friends, grab a drink, and enjoy a night full of entertainment, music, and pure drag magic in an intimate setting. During events, or by appointment. For more information or to schedule an appointment, get in touch
